{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "PCR setup with master mix, water, and 24 samples",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tips = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 2)
    tube_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 3)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 4)
    
    # Define liquids
    protocol.define_liquid(
        name="master mix",
        description="2x PCR master mix with primers",
        display_color="#FF6600"
    )
    protocol.define_liquid(
        name="water",
        description="Nuclease-free water",
        display_color="#0000FF"
    )
    # Define 24 samples
    for i in range(1, 25):
        protocol.define_liquid(
            name=f"sample {i}",
            description=f"Genomic DNA sample {i}",
            display_color="#00FF00"
        )
    
    # Load liquids into source wells
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid="master mix", volume=300)
    reservoir["A2"].load_liquid(liquid="water", volume=300)
    sample_well_names = ["A1","A2","A3","A4","A5","A6","B1","B2","B3","B4","B5","B6","C1","C2","C3","C4","C5","C6","D1","D2","D3","D4","D5","D6"]
    for i, well_name in enumerate(sample_well_names):
        tube_rack[well_name].load_liquid(liquid=f"sample {i+1}", volume=10)
    
    # Load the multi-channel pipette
    p300_multi = protocol.load_instrument("p300_multi_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips])
    
    # Prepare destination wells (24 wells in columns A and B)
    dest_wells = []
    for col in ["A", "B"]:
        for row in range(1, 13):
            dest_wells.append(plate[f"{col}{row}"])
    
    # Step 1: Distribute master mix + water mixture (12.5 ul + 10.5 ul = 23 ul) to each destination well
    p300_multi.pick_up_tip()
    p300_multi.aspirate(12.5, reservoir["A1"])  # master mix
    p300_multi.aspirate(10.5, reservoir["A2"])  # water
    p300_multi.dispense(23, dest_wells)
    p300_multi.drop_tip()
    
    # Step 2: Add 2 ul of DNA from each sample to the corresponding well
    source_wells = sample_well_names
    batch1_sources = source_wells[:12]
    batch2_sources = source_wells[12:]
    batch1_dests = dest_wells[:12]
    batch2_dests = dest_wells[12:]
    
    # First batch of DNA transfers
    p300_multi.pick_up_tip()
    p300_multi.aspirate(2, batch1_sources)
    p300_multi.dispense(2, batch1_dests)
    p300_multi.drop_tip()
    
    # Second batch of DNA transfers
    p300_multi.pick_up_tip()
    p300_multi.aspirate(2, batch2_sources)
    p300_multi.dispense(2, batch2_dests)
    p300_multi.drop_tip()"}

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "PCR setup with master mix, water, and 24 samples",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tips = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 2)
    tube_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 3)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 4)
    
    # Define liquids and keep references
    master_mix = protocol.define_liquid(
        name="master mix",
        description="2x PCR master mix with primers",
        display_color="#FF6600"
    )
    water = protocol.define_liquid(
        name="water",
        description="Nuclease-free water",
        display_color="#0000FF"
    )
    samples = {}
    for i in range(1, 25):
        samples[f"sample {i}"] = protocol.define_liquid(
            name=f"sample {i}",
            description=f"Genomic DNA sample {i}",
            display_color="#00FF00"
        )
    
    # Load liquids into source wells
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=master_mix, volume=300)
    reservoir["A2"].load_liquid(liquid=water, volume=300)
    sample_well_names = ["A1","A2","A3","A4","A5","A6","B1","B2","B3","B4","B5","B6","C1","C2","C3","C4","C5","C6","D1","D2","D3","D4","D5","D6"]
    for i, well_name in enumerate(sample_well_names):
        tube_rack[well_name].load_liquid(liquid=samples[f"sample {i+1}"], volume=10)
    
    # Load the multi-channel pipette
    p300_multi = protocol.load_instrument("p300_multi_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips])
    
    # Prepare destination wells (24 wells in columns A and B)
    dest_wells = []
    for col in ["A", "B"]:
        for row in range(1, 13):
            dest_wells.append(plate[f"{col}{row}"])
    
    # Step 1: Distribute master mix + water mixture (12.5 ul + 10.5 ul = 23 ul) to each destination well
    p300_multi.pick_up_tip()
    p300_multi.aspirate(12.5, reservoir["A1"])  # master mix
    p300_multi.aspirate(10.5, reservoir["A2"])  # water
    p300_multi.dispense(23, dest_wells)
    p300_multi.drop_tip()
    
    # Step 2: Add 2 ul of DNA from each sample to the corresponding well
    source_wells = sample_well_names
    batch1_sources = source_wells[:12]
    batch2_sources = source_wells[12:]
    batch1_dests = dest_wells[:12]
    batch2_dests = dest_wells[12:]
    
    # First batch of DNA transfers
    p300_multi.pick_up_tip()
    p300_multi.aspirate(2, batch1_sources)
    p300_multi.dispense(2, batch1_dests)
    p300_multi.drop_tip()
    
    # Second batch of DNA transfers
    p300_multi.pick_up_tip()
    p300_multi.aspirate(2, batch2_sources)
    p300_multi.dispense(2, batch2_dests)
    p300_multi.drop_tip()"}

        description="Nuclease-free water",
        display_color="#0000FF"
    )
    samples = {}
    for i in range(1, 25):

            name=f"sample {i}",
            description=f"Genomic DNA sample {i}",
            display_color="#00FF00"
        )
    
    # Load liquids into source wells
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=master_mix, volume=300)
    reservoir["A2"].load_liquid(liquid=water, volume=300)

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "PCR setup with master mix, water, and 24 samples",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tips = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 2)
    tube_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 3)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 4)
    
    # Define liquids and keep references
    master_mix = protocol.define_liquid(
        name="master mix",
        description="2x PCR master mix with primers",
        display_color="#FF6600"
    )
    water = protocol.define_liquid(
        name="water",
        description="Nuclease-free water",
        display_color="#0000FF"
    )
    samples = {}
    for i in range(1, 25):
        samples[f"sample {i}"] = protocol.define_liquid(
            name=f"sample {i}",
            description=f"Genomic DNA sample {i}",
            display_color="#00FF00"
        )
    
    # Load liquids into source wells
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=master_mix, volume=300)
    reservoir["A2"].load_liquid(liquid=water, volume=300)
    sample_well_names = ["A1","A2","A3","A4","A4","A5","A6","B1","B2","B3","B4","B5","B6","C1","C2","C3","C4","C5","C6","D1","D2","D3","D4","D5","D6"]
    for i, well_name in enumerate(sample_well_names):
        tube_rack[well_name].load_liquid(liquid=samples[f"sample {i+1}"], volume=10)
    
    # Load single-channel pipette for master mix and water distribution
    p300_single = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips])
    
    # Prepare destination wells (24 wells in columns A and B)
    dest_wells = []
    for col in ["A", "B"]:
        for row in range(1, 13):
            dest_wells.append(plate[f"{col}{row}"])
    
    # Step 1: Distribute master mix (12.5 ul) to each destination well
    p300_single.transfer(
        volume=12.5,
        source=reservoir["A1"],
        destinations=dest_wells,
        new_tip="always"
    )
    
    # Step 2: Distribute water (10.5 ul) to each destination well
    p300_single.transfer(
        volume=10.5,
        source=reservoir["A2"],
        destinations=dest_wells,
        new_tip="always"
    )
    
    # Load multi-channel pipette for DNA transfers
    p300_multi = protocol.load_instrument("p300_multi_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips])
    
    # Step 3: Add 2 ul of DNA from each sample to the corresponding well
    source_wells = sample_well_names
    batch1_sources = source_wells[:12]
    batch2_sources = source_wells[12:]
    batch1_dests = dest_wells[:12]
    batch2_dests = dest_wells[12:]
    
    # First batch of DNA transfers
    p300_multi.pick_up_tip()
    p300_multi.aspirate(2, batch1_sources)
    for well in batch1_dests:
        p300_multi.dispense(2, well)
    p300_multi.drop_tip()
    
    # Second batch of DNA transfers
    p300_multi.pick_up_tip()
    p300_multi.aspirate(2, batch2_sources)
    for well in batch2_dests:
        p300_multi.dispense(2, well)
    p300_multi.drop_tip()"}

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "PCR setup with master mix, water, and 24 samples",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tips = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 2)
    tube_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 3)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 4)
    
    # Define liquids and keep references
    master_mix = protocol.define_liquid(
        name="master mix",
        description="2x PCR master mix with primers",
        display_color="#FF6600"
    )
    water = protocol.define_liquid(
        name="water",
        description="Nuclease-free water",
        display_color="#0000FF"
    )
    samples = {}
    for i in range(1, 25):
        samples[f"sample {i}"] = protocol.define_liquid(
            name=f"sample {i}",
            description=f"Genomic DNA sample {i}",
            display_color="#00FF00"
        )
    
    # Load liquids into source wells
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=master_mix, volume=300)
    reservoir["A2"].load_liquid(liquid=water, volume=300)
    
    # Manually define the 24 well names in the tube rack
    sample_well_names = ["A1","A2","A3","A4","A5","A6","B1","B2","B3","B4","B5","B6","C1","C2","C3","C4","C5","C6","D1","D2","D3","D4","D5","D6"]
    for i, well_name in enumerate(sample_well_names):
        tube_rack[well_name].load_liquid(liquid=samples[f"sample {i+1}"], volume=10)
    
    # Load single-channel pipette for master mix and water distribution
    p300_single = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips])
    
    # Prepare destination wells (24 wells in columns A and B)
    dest_wells = []
    for col in ["A", "B"]:
        for row in range(1, 13):
            dest_wells.append(plate[f"{col}{row}"])
    
    # Step 1: Distribute master mix (12.5 ul) to each destination well
    p300_single.transfer(
        volume=12.5,
        source=reservoir["A1"],
        destinations=dest_wells,
        new_tip="always"
    )
    
    # Step 2: Distribute water (10.5 ul) to each destination well
    p300_single.transfer(
        volume=10.5,
        source=reservoir["A2"],
        destinations=dest_wells,
        new_tip="always"
    )
    
    # Load multi-channel pipette for DNA transfers
    p300_multi = protocol.load_instrument("p300_multi_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips])
    
    # Step 3: Add 2 ul of DNA from each sample to the corresponding well
    source_wells = sample_well_names
    batch1_sources = source_wells[:12]
    batch2_sources = source_wells[12:]
    batch1_dests = dest_wells[:12]
    batch2_dests = dest_wells[12:]
    
    # First batch of DNA transfers
    p300_multi.pick_up_tip()
    p300_multi.aspirate(2, batch1_sources)
    for well in batch1_dests:
        p300_multi.dispense(2, well)
    p300_multi.drop_tip()
    
    # Second batch of DNA transfers
    p300_multi.pick_up_tip()
    p300_multi.aspirate(2, batch2_sources)
    for well in batch2_dests:
        p300_multi.dispense(2, well)
    p300_multi.drop_tip()"}

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "PCR setup with master mix, water, and 24 samples",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tips = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 2)
    tube_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 3)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 4)
    
    # Define liquids and keep references
    master_mix = protocol.define_liquid(
        name="master mix",
        description="2x PCR master mix with primers",
        display_color="#FF6600"
    )
    water = protocol.define_liquid(
        name="water",
        description="Nuclease-free water",
        display_color="#0000FF"
    )
    samples = {}
    for i in range(1, 25):
        samples[f"sample {i}"] = protocol.define_liquid(
            name=f"sample {i}",
            description=f"Genomic DNA sample {i}",
            display_color="#00FF00"
        )
    
    # Load liquids into source wells
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=master_mix, volume=300)
    reservoir["A2"].load_liquid(liquid=water, volume=300)
    
    # Manually define the 24 well names in the tube rack
    sample_well_names = ["A1","A2","A3","A4","A5","A6","B1","B2","B3","B4","B5","B6","C1","C2","C3","C4","C5","C6","D1","D2","D3","D4","D5","D6"]
    for i, well_name in enumerate(sample_well_names):
        tube_rack[well_name].load_liquid(liquid=samples[f"sample {i+1}"], volume=10)
    
    # Load single-channel pipette for master mix and water distribution (p20 for 1-20 ul)
    p20_single = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips])
    
    # Prepare destination wells (24 wells in columns A and B)
    dest_wells = []
    for col in ["A", "B"]:
        for row in range(1, 13):
            dest_wells.append(plate[f"{col}{row}"])
    
    # Step 1: Distribute master mix (12.5 ul) to each destination well
    p20_single.transfer(
        volume=12.5,
        source=reservoir["A1"],
        dest=dest_wells,
        new_tip="always"
    )
    
    # Step 2: Distribute water (10.5 ul) to each destination well
    p20_single.transfer(
        volume=10.5,
        source=reservoir["A2"],
        dest=dest_wells,
        new_tip="always"
    )
    
    # Load multi-channel pipette for DNA transfers on left mount (p20 for 1-20 ul)
    p20_multi = protocol.load_instrument("p20_multi_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tips])
    
    # Step 3: Add 2 ul of DNA from each sample to the corresponding well
    source_well_names = sample_well_names
    batch1_source_names = source_well_names[:12]
    batch2_source_names = source_well_names[12:]
    
    # Convert source well names to well objects
    batch1_sources = [tube_rack[name] for name in batch1_source_names]
    batch2_sources = [tube_rack[name] for name in batch2_source_names]
    
    batch1_dests = dest_wells[:12]
    batch2_dests = dest_wells[12:]
    
    # First batch of DNA transfers
    p20_multi.pick_up_tip()
    for i in range(len(batch1_sources)):
        p20_multi.aspirate(2, batch1_sources[i])
        p20_multi.dispense(2, batch1_dests[i])
    p20_multi.drop_tip()
    
    # Second batch of DNA transfers
    p20_multi.pick_up_tip()
    for i in range(len(batch2_sources)):
        p20_multi.aspirate(2, batch2_sources[i])
        p20_multi.dispense(2, batch2_dests[i])
    p20_multi.drop_tip()"}

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "PCR setup with master mix, water, and 24 samples",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tips = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 2)
    tube_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 3)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 4)
    
    # Define liquids and keep references
    master_mix = protocol.define_liquid(
        name="master mix",
        description="2x PCR master mix with primers",
        display_color="#FF6600"
    )
    water = protocol.define_liquid(
        name="water",
        description="Nuclease-free water",
        display_color="#0000FF"
    )
    samples = {}
    for i in range(1, 25):
        samples[f"sample {i}"] = protocol.define_liquid(
            name=f"sample {i}",
            description=f"Genomic DNA sample {i}",
            display_color="#00FF00"
        )
    
    # Load liquids into source wells
    # Load master mix into a dedicated tube in the tube rack (well A1)
    tube_rack["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=master_mix, volume=300)
    # Load water into reservoir well A2
    reservoir["A2"].load_liquid(liquid=water, volume=300)
    # Load samples into tube rack wells
    sample_well_names = ["A1","A2","A3","A4","A5","A6","B1","B2","B3","B4","B5","B6","C1","C2","C3","C4","C5","C6","D1","D2","D3","D4","D5","D6"]
    for i, well_name in enumerate(sample_well_names):
        tube_rack[well_name].load_liquid(liquid=samples[f"sample {i+1}"], volume=10)
    
    # Load single-channel pipette for master mix and water distribution
    p20_single = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips])
    
    # Prepare destination wells (24 wells in columns A and B)
    dest_wells = []
    for col in ["A", "B"]:
        for row in range(1, 13):
            dest_wells.append(plate[f"{col}{row}"])
    
    # Step 1: Distribute master mix (12.5 ul) to each destination well
    # Use a fresh tip for each transfer to avoid contamination
    for well in dest_wells:
        p20_single.pick_up_tip()
        p20_single.aspirate(12.5, tube_rack["A1"])  # master mix
        p20_single.dispense(12.5, well)
        p20_single.drop_tip()
    
    # Step 2: Distribute water (10.5 ul) to each destination well
    for well in dest_wells:
        p20_single.pick_up_tip()
        p20_single.aspirate(10.5, reservoir["A2"])  # water
        p20_single.dispense(10.5, well)
        p20_single.drop_tip()
    
    # Load multi-channel pipette for DNA transfers on left mount
    p20_multi = protocol.load_instrument("p20_multi_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tips])
    
    # Step 3: Add 2 ul of DNA from each sample to the corresponding well
    source_well_names = sample_well_names
    batch1_source_names = source_well_names[:12]
    batch2_source_names = source_well_names[12:]
    
    # Convert source well names to well objects
    batch1_sources = [tube_rack[name] for name in batch1_source_names]
    batch2_sources = [tube_rack[name] for name in batch2_source_names]
    
    batch1_dests = dest_wells[:12]
    batch2_dests = dest_wells[12:]
    
    # First batch of DNA transfers
    p20_multi.pick_up_tip()
    for i in range(len(batch1_sources)):
        p20_multi.aspirate(2, batch1_sources[i])
        p20_multi.dispense(2, batch1_dests[i])
    p20_multi.drop_tip()
    
    # Second batch of DNA transfers
    p20_multi.pick_up_tip()
    for i in range(len(batch2_sources)):
        p20_multi.aspirate(2, batch2_sources[i])
        p20_multi.dispense(2, batch2_dests[i])
    p20_multi.drop_tip()"}

findings.title: The pipette draws air from well A2 in slot 2: the liquid is below the tip
findings.fix: Keep the liquid above the tip. This well needs about 258 ul in it for the surface to reach 1 mm. Load that much more than the run draws; or draw from a smaller vessel (a tube lifts the liquid); or aspirate lower with `well.bottom(0.5)`.

findings.title: A used tip went into a stock: 23 stocks
findings.fix: Pick up a fresh tip before line 86 goes into the stock. Or change the order: hand out the shared liquid first, while the tip is still clean, and add the other liquids afterwards with a fresh tip each.

findings.title: A used tip went into a stock: 10 stocks

findings.title: A used tip carried sample 13 (tube C1 in slot 3), sample 14 (tube C2 in slot 3), sample 15 (tube C3 in slot 3), sample 16 (tube C4 in slot 3) and 2 more into 6 wells it was never meant for
findings.fix: Use a fresh tip for each well at line 94. If one tip must serve many wells, dispense from above the liquid (for example `well.top()`) so that the tip never touches what is already in the well.
